cgroup.scope: Cgroup counters include descendants and kernel/cache charges; not the sum of native worker RSS. No counter resets or configuration writes.

native_observations.scope: Read-only Linux-reported virtual/resident values. RSS accounting is approximate; a sampled high-water value can miss a later peak. Not a measured final per-attempt peak or long-chain memory bound.
